versions.label: Latest development build — House Cat, now walking
changes: This is the current normal first-level build, packaged for the browser without Web-only gameplay changes.
The House Cat uses two walk frames while moving and the original sprite while standing still.
The normal title, pause, quit-to-title, damage, death, and same-seed restart flow is included.
controls: Press Enter on the title screen to start.
Press Enter or R after defeat to restart.
limitations: Unfinished first-level development build with prototype House Cat art and placeholder enemies.
Eighteen Rats spawn once; there is no timed stream or win condition.
Automatic Claw may defeat every Rat before the House Cat, so the defeat summary and post-defeat restart may not appear in normal play.
XP, progression, choices, and rewards are not implemented.
Exit ends the browser session. Reload the page to start again.
Verified in desktop Chromium with a keyboard. Other browsers, controllers, and touch input are untested.
